A block marker on a continuation line of a link label is escaped

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"https://example.com\">Alpha<br>-<br>Beta</a>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
